title: Karpo
shortDescription: The Windows taskbar, with your day in it. See your next meeting, new emails, the weather and your music at a glance, and open folders full of widgets with one click. Free to start, no ads, no account.
description: Karpo is a taskbar for Windows 11 and Windows 10 that looks just like the one Windows comes with. The difference: your day is in it. Your next meeting, your newest emails, the weather, your music and how hard your PC is working sit right beside your apps, and every one of them opens with a click.
YOUR DAY, RIGHT ON THE TASKBAR
• Your next meeting with a countdown, and a button to join it
• New emails as they come in, with the unread count
• Your whole week in one click from the clock
• Microsoft accounts (Outlook.com, Microsoft 365), any IMAP email account, and CalDAV and CardDAV calendars and contacts such as iCloud, Fastmail or Nextcloud
WHAT YOU CHECK ALL DAY, AT A GLANCE
• The weather now, by the hour and for the week
• Your music, with play, pause and skip right on the taskbar
• Processor, memory, graphics, network and disks, with live graphs
• Clocks for other cities, timers and alarms
• Stocks, RSS feeds, notifications, your latest files
• Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, volume, brightness and battery
FOLDERS YOU FILL WITH WIDGETS
Gather widgets into a folder on the taskbar. One click opens it as your own little dashboard: clocks for three cities, today's agenda, your inbox and the forecast. Click away and it's gone.
A LAYOUT FOR EVERY PART OF YOUR DAY
A full taskbar for work with your calendar and mail. A dock for the evening with music and the weather. Nothing but a timer when you need to focus. Switch in two clicks, or give every screen its own.
ON EVERY SCREEN, ON ANY EDGE
Karpo puts a taskbar on every monitor. Each one can sit at the bottom, the top, the left or the right, with its own layout.
MAKE IT YOURS

Right-click the taskbar and choose Edit. Add widgets from the list, drag them where you want them, and change their size and look right on the taskbar. Every setting is there too, in the taskbar itself.
LOOKS LIKE WINDOWS
Start, search, your pinned and open apps, the system tray and the clock look and work just like Windows' own. Karpo follows your light or dark theme, your accent colour and your text size.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN

Karpo has no ads, no tracking, no analytics and no account. It only ever reads your mail and calendar: it can't send an email or change an event. Your sign-ins are encrypted by Windows for your Windows user alone, and your data stays on your PC. Karpo has no servers of its own.
LIGHT ON YOUR PC
Karpo shows its taskbar a fraction of a second after it starts and uses very little memory and power while you aren't looking at it, so your PC stays fast and your battery lasts.
ALWAYS YOUR CHOICE
Quit Karpo any time and the Windows taskbar comes back just as it was. Start and search stay Windows' own.
FREE TO START

Every widget and every setting is in the free version, with up to 20 widgets per layout and 2 layouts. Karpo Pro, one purchase in Karpo through the Microsoft Store, lifts both limits for good. No subscription.
In 40 languages. Weather data by Open-Meteo.com.
